text: Now, the really clever part.
Under the stars, there's a row of little red icons.
Each icon is one thing the police know about you.
It's basically their notebook right there on your screen.
A person icon. They know what you look like.
A clothing icon. They know what you're wearing.
A car icon. They know your vehicle.
A weapon icon. They saw what you were carrying.
A camera icon. You got caught on CCTV.
TV. And two little people. They know Jason and Lucia were together. Six icons. Six clues.
And here's the fun part. You can erase them one by one. Clothes known? Change your outfit.
Hit a clothing store or, and I love this, grab a spare outfit from the trunk of your
own car. Face known? Get a haircut. Or, plan ahead and put on a mask before the crime
even starts. Car known? Dump it, swap it, or get it re-sprayed. In one preview demo, the
player switched cars, the car icon vanished, and a police cruiser drove straight past them.
No idea. Weapon known? Stash it. Caught on camera? Get rid of the footage. In Rockstar's
extended look, the crew even sets their getaway car on fire to destroy the evidence. And
if the police are looking for a couple? Split up! Send Jason one way and Lucia the other.
reports say that alone can knock a star off her wanted level.
Okay, remember those red stars? Here's why they matter.
When you escape a chase in GTA VI, it is NOT over.
The area where you did the crime becomes a hot area.
Police stay there, holding your description.
Walk back in wearing the same clothes, driving the same car, and the chase starts all over again.
So you can't just circle the block anymore.
You have to actually change something, or stay away until things cool down.
And at 6 stars, the hot area is the entire map.
There is nowhere to cool off.
All of Leonida is looking for you.
And it gets harder.
In GTA V, every cop was a blip on your minimap with a nice little vision cone.
In GTA VI, those blips are gone.
If you want to know where the police are, you have to look with your eyes.
There is a focus ability that highlights nearby officers, even through walls, but you have
to choose to use it.
Rockstar even showed Jason crouching behind cover, slipping out of an officer's line
of sight.
This is a stealth game now!
